description: When the traveller tells you they booked a hotel after a check_direct_price answer, report whether they booked it on the hotel's own website, with the check_id. Only report what the traveller told you. Nothing about the traveller is sent or kept: only that the check led to a booking, and its total when given.

booked_direct.description: true when the traveller booked on the hotel's own website; false when they booked elsewhere or not at all.

total_paid.description: The total the traveller says they paid, in euros, when they say it.

name: report_booking
title: Report that the traveller booked
